context.instructions: Relier les retours natifs à leur portée exacte : 53 contextes ; 14 wrappers10E3270 construits puis arrêt avant pixels, 25 retours complets989500 avec AL1 mais texture8C nulle. limits: Original code executes conditionally with declared backend/category and COM results/objects. No actual GPU texture or historical process/device is created.
COM GetDeviceCaps,CreateTexture,AddRef,Release,GetLevelCount and GetLevelDesc are explicit adapters; native wrappers and null guard execute. Successful path stops before pixel copy.
The metadata39 API and Vulkan GPU results are inherited, not replayed. Category current=null and runtime allocator/cookie are declared.

Initialized default-CRT allocator profile is declared (flag2D77B20=1,custom14BEF58/14BEF40=0), bootstrap not run. Cookie-check leaf preserves EAX as the original successful CMP/RET does. Allocation is zero-initialized in a separate bounded pool; wrapper20byte allocation is explicitly refused in its dedicated profiles. This is a probe input, not an actual OS allocation failure.

Generic creation errors stop before native diagnostic lookup; full logging/error propagation is not qualified. Loader AL1 is measured separately from texture pointer/TLS and does not establish readiness.

The first probe clobbered EAX in its cookie adapter and reached an undeclared allocator initialization context:39memory stops,14bounded diagnostics passed; code2 and all observations retained. Corrected inputs do not establish the original bootstrap.
Native9C97C0 and its metadata getters execute with declared COM descriptors, not actual GPU resource memory measurement or a proven registration role.
Eight current consumer descriptors remain unchanged; these contracts are not an implementation or acceptance of their missing normal screen continuations.
